title: Stage 11 — Production Environment Certification & Deployment Readiness
summary: Environment was reset between stages; recovered from remote after confirming the exact expected commit (c0ea8f3). No real external infrastructure is available (no DATABASE_URL, no GROQ_API_KEY, no object-storage sidecar, no browser).
